findings.current: The Jin Family’s Spear Technique Jin Mukyung was using now was no different.

findings.current:
- The **Paralysis Acupoint** has been subdued. You will be paralyzed for two hours!
>
> - The **Mute Acupoint** has been subdued. You will be unable to make a sound for two hours!
findings.defect: “Acupoint has been subdued” is an unnatural collocation that reads like an untranslated system message.
findings.rationale: “Sealed” is natural wuxia terminology for disabling someone through an acupoint and remains consistent with the later notices that the effects have been released.
findings.replacement:
- The **Paralysis Acupoint** has been sealed. You will be paralyzed for two hours!
>
> - The **Mute Acupoint** has been sealed. You will be unable to make a sound for two hours!
findings.source: Chapter 71, System panel after Jin Mukyung strikes Taekyung’s acupoints

findings.current: To cut to the end of the story, Jin Mukyung agreed to go to the Mount Heng Sword Sect as well.
findings.defect: “To cut to the end of the story” is an awkward literalized idiom rather than natural contemporary narration.
findings.rationale: The replacement fits Taekyung’s brisk conversational voice without changing the transition or its meaning.
findings.replacement: Long story short, Jin Mukyung agreed to go to the Mount Heng Sword Sect as well.
findings.source: Chapter 74, transition to Jin Mukyung accepting the trip

findings.current: “……Only an idiot would take that at face value.”
findings.defect: The line uses two consecutive ellipsis characters, inconsistent with the packet’s prescribed single ellipsis character and the formatting used elsewhere.
findings.rationale: A single ellipsis preserves the pause while following the binding punctuation standard.
findings.replacement: “…Only an idiot would take that at face value.”
findings.source: Chapter 73, Jin Mukyung’s reply after using Sword Energy

summary: The packet preserves the established voice, terminology, hooks, and active continuity well. One speaker-attribution error creates an internal contradiction, while several smaller issues involve unnatural English and inconsistent ellipsis formatting.
